name: gru-toolchain
description: Node 22 lane for GRU: Wrangler (dev/deploy/D1), workerd integration tests, Vite web build, ESLint. Install with Node >=22.12 only (D-028).

scripts.test: npm run build:web && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix .. run check && npm run check && wrangler deploy --config ../wrangler.jsonc
